gizmo.title: Umdlalo woFambo lemibono
gizmo.description: Ihlabathi elivulekileyo lokuzulazula. Imibono ikufumana ize ibuze umbuzo. Phendula ngokuchanekileyo ukuze woyise omnye uvule indlu yawo. Ishwankathelo libonisa iinzame nento ekufuneka uyibuyekeze.

configure.title: Uhambo
configure.description: Umyalelo ochazwe kwiscreen sokuqala. Xelela umdlali ukuba uhambo lwenzelwe ntoni.

configure.title: Emva komdlalo
configure.description: Ukhetho. Ithatha indawo yebhokisi yokukopa umyalelo kwiphaneli yokugqibela ngomxholo wakho, onjengesinyathelo esilandelayo okanye ulwalamano.

configure.title: Amaqhosha ongezelelweyo emva komdlalo
configure.description: Ukhetho. Amaqhosha okanye ulwalamano oluboniswa ecaleni kwe Dlala kwakhona kwiphaneli yokugqibela.

advanced.title: Iintliziyo
advanced.description: Iimpendulo ezingachanekanga ngaphambi kokuba umbono ubaleke.

advanced.title: Imbewu yomlinganiswa
advanced.description: Nawuphi na umbhalo. Imbewu efanayo yenza umlinganiswa ofanayo rhoqo. Le yimbewu efanayo esetyenziswa yi-avatar ye-HAX.

advanced.title: Sebenzisa umlinganiswa womntu ongenileyo
advanced.description: Xa umntu engene kwi-HAX, umlinganiswa ubonakala efana ne-avatar yakhe. Wonke umntu osele ubona imbewu engentla.

advanced.title: Umgca ongaphezu komyalelo
advanced.description: Shiya ungenanto ukuze usebenzise umgca ovelele.

advanced.title: Umyalelo wokukopa
advanced.description: Uboniswa kwiphaneli yokugqibela kunye neqhosha lokukopa. Cima ukuze ufihle ibhokisi.

advanced.title: Igama lomdlalo
advanced.description: Linika lo mdlalo igama kwiziganeko zenkqubela kunye ne-OER Schema markup.

advanced.title: I-ID yomdlalo
advanced.description: Ukhetho. Ohlula lo mdlalo kwabanye kwiphepha kwiziganeko zenkqubela.
